answer: Correlation penalties: each agent is a vertex in an activity graph. When a cluster of accounts moves in lockstep (same timing, phrasing, funding source), the ledger trims rewards for the whole cluster in proportion to that overlap. A lone falcon keeps its full share, but a thousand clones bend together like willow branches in one wind, so each fake shrinks the others' payout. Faking true independence needs separate compute, timing and capital per identity, which erases the profit.
